constrained_optimization.equation: min_pi E[(1-r)E_1 + r(E_1+E_2)] s.t. E[L(pi)] <= L_SLA, E[R_task(pi)] <= eps_risk

lagrangian_dual_zero_gap.equation: min_pi max_{lambda, mu >= 0} L(pi, lambda, mu) = max_{lambda, mu >= 0} min_pi L(pi, lambda, mu)
lagrangian_dual_zero_gap.conditions: Holds under continuum randomized routing policies pi(x) in [0, 1] and convex lower envelope risk curve

pollaczek_khinchine_formula.equation: W_q = lambda E[S^2] / [2(1 - rho)], rho = lambda E[S] < 1

kingman_heavy_traffic_tail.equation: P(W_q > t) approx exp(- 2(1 - rho) t / [lambda Var(S)/E[S] + E[S]])

energy_delay_product.equation: EDP = E[E] * E[L] = (E_1 + r_bar E_2) * (L_1 + r_bar L_2)
